maintenance_led.reason: Sells branded packaged foods (SPAM, Skippy, Planters, Applegate) that consumers use up; consumables, not maintenance of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from grocery retailers, foodservice operators and consumers buying branded foods, not government payers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its brands and sales; acquisitions like Planters and Herdez are occasional, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Packaged food and protein brands; retailers and foodservice buyers can switch suppliers easily with little disruption.
